syllabus_topics: Kinematics and dynamics of ideal and real fluids
Hydraulic resistances and calculation of pipelines and channels
Resistance of streamlined bodies and wings

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (theoretical questions and problem solving)

assessment_rules: The requirement to have a term validated is the submission of the course assignment and the written statements from the laboratory classes. The exam is in a written form, including short answers to theoretical questions and a solution of a certain number of problems.
